## AccrualPosition.maxBorrowableAssets property

The maximum additional amount of assets that can be borrowed against this position's collateral. `undefined` if the market's oracle is undefined or reverts.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get maxBorrowableAssets(): bigint | undefined;
```
